Milestone 4 (`robofab-cell`) of the robofab track. Stylised, simulation-only, standard library only, illustrative (unmeasured) parameters.

- Discrete-event model of 1 arm, 1–8 printers, 1 inspection station; 30 parts, 200 replications with common random numbers.
- Findings: printers have the highest utilisation at every size, yet at 6 printers an extra arm saves 10.9 min vs 2.3 for an extra inspection station; SPT/LPT trade flow time vs makespan as textbook predicts; a mean-value twin is optimistic.
- 9 unit tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok. README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added.
- Citations (Graham 1969; Pinedo 2016) are from memory and flagged as unverified online in the README.
